BiblicalUsage: Silla is the place where Joash is struck down by his servants, in the house of Millo on the way down to Silla. The name appears once, as the road where a king's life ends. Joash, who repaired the temple as a boy, dies by conspiracy as a man.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Silla is a sober reminder that a good beginning does not guarantee a good end, and kings need God to the last.
